item.title: Version 3.33.0
item.description:
• Reload Track Info: right-click a setlist row — or a selection — and choose Reload Track Info to re-read the tags from the file. Fixes rows that show a filename with no artist or genre because the file sat on a sleeping, slow or network drive when it was dropped in. Rows that never got a successful read are retried automatically at every launch. Worth fixing: a track with no genre counts as a cortina under the deny-list rule, so a failed tag read also throws off tanda counting and the “Coming Up” preview.
  • Plugin tweaks survive the set: with a default plugin configuration set, the chain was re-applied on every track load, wiping any adjustment made live. It now re-applies only when the configuration actually changes.
  • ShellacFilters v1.0.1: re-vendored declick and dehum cores. The dehum detector now runs on a decimated signal — far less work per detection pass, same result — and declick no longer allocates ~2.1 MB per channel on the audio thread. The upstream version is shown in the Restoration popover.
  • Output device: pick your interface by name rather than System Default — on System Default the player follows whatever macOS calls the default, so plugging in headphones moves its output. If the chosen device disconnects, playback stops with an Audio Device Unavailable alert offering Retry; it never silently falls back to another output.

item.title: Version 3.32.0
item.description:
• Edit Upcoming Info: right-click a cortina in the setlist and choose Edit Upcoming Info… to type the artist, singer and year shown in the “Coming Up” preview during that cortina — for mixed tandas where the first track’s own details would misdescribe what’s next. Year is free text (“1941-43”). Blank fields fall back to the real details, and editing the cortina that is already playing updates the display immediately. Built-in player only.
  • Playback survives sleep: waking the Mac no longer quits TangoDisplay or leaves it silent. The audio engine is restarted with retries while the output device comes back, exclusive (hog) mode is re-claimed, and if the device does not return playback stops with an Audio Device Unavailable alert offering Retry.

item.title: Version 3.31.0
item.description:
• Shellac Restoration: new Restoration button in the Setlist toolbar, with Declick and Dehum filters for 78 rpm transfers, running ahead of the equaliser. Off by default. Per-track overrides (right-click a row) outrank both the master switch and the cortina skip, so a single shellac transfer can be repaired in an otherwise unrestored set.
  • Music start/stop times re-read on every drop: trim markers imported from Music (Song Info > Options) now reflect edits made after TangoDisplay launched, and are imported correctly for iTunes-purchased tracks that arrive as file promises. Previously the times were read once per session and matched by file path.
  • Slider knobs on macOS 26: sliders in the EQ, Balance, ReplayGain and Auto-gap popovers no longer draw a track with no knob until first clicked.
  • Credits: the restoration filters are the DSP cores from ShellacFilters by Nick Shaforostov (MIT), built on the Airwindows framework by Chris Johnson; the Audio Unit wrapper is adapted from EmbraceNG (© 2024 Ricci Adams, MIT / 1-clause BSD).

item.title: Version 3.30.0
item.description: • Skip gap after manual stop: new option in Settings > Player > Auto-gap. When a track is stopped before it ends, the next track you start plays immediately with no silence preroll. Covers the transport stop button and Fade & Stop. Off by default, so existing behaviour is unchanged.

item.title: Version 3.29.1
item.description:
• Sub-second trim precision: the Track Start & End editor now accepts tenth-of-a-second times (m:ss.d) and allows windows as short as 0.1s.
  • Auto-gap respects trims: silence past a trimmed end or before a trimmed start is no longer counted toward the auto-gap target, so trimming a track no longer collapses the gap before the next one.
  • Missing-file drop alert: dropping tracks whose files can't be found now shows an alert dialog instead of a brief inline note.

item.title: Version 3.29.0
item.description:
• Import Music start/stop times as trim markers: when the built-in player is active, dropping tracks from Music now reads each track's start/stop times (Song Info → Options) and applies them as playback trim markers automatically.
  • Skip missing files on drop: tracks whose underlying file no longer exists (shown with a warning triangle in Music) are now rejected on drop with a "not found" note, instead of silently being skipped at playback.
  • Genre lists now stored as JSON rather than comma-joined text, so genres containing a comma work correctly. Existing settings migrate automatically.

item.title: Version 3.28.1
item.description: • Fixed a crash (JRiver): rapidly rebuilding or re-picking the Playing Now list could momentarily leave JRiver without a valid playing position, which crashed TangoDisplay while showing the next track during a cortina. The playlist position is now clamped safely.

item.title: Version 3.28.0
item.description:
• Track Start & End Time: new context-menu action to trim any track's playback to a sub-range, so you can replay a track from a mid-point (e.g. during applause after a performance).
  • Editor window with draggable start/end handles over the waveform (dulled outside the selection) plus manual m:ss entry. Trimmed tracks show a start-end badge; Clear Start & End Time removes it.
  • Works with Repeat Track (loops the trimmed range). Built-in player only.

item.title: Version 3.27.0
item.description:
• Repeat Track: mark a non-dance track to repeat until 'stop-after' or un-marked. Blue repeat icon, context-menu toggle, mutually exclusive with stop-after, cleared by fade actions.
  • Fixed: context menu now correctly resumes auto-gap on the first track when auto-gap is auto-applied by the global setting.

item.title: Version 3.26.6
item.description: • Built-in player: fixed auto-gap silence sometimes applied to the wrong track after reordering, skipping, or marking tracks played.

item.title: Version 3.26.5
item.description: • When Hide Played is on, a banner now shows how many played tracks are hidden.

item.title: Version 3.26.4
item.description:
• Setlist playback now continues uninterrupted even when the Mac would otherwise idle-sleep (notably on battery).
  • Dragged-in tracks now appear instantly and fill in their details a moment later, instead of seeming to fail.
  • Cloud-only Music.app tracks in a mixed selection are now downloaded and added in full rather than being silently skipped.
  • The duplicate-track prompt now reports how many tracks are affected and whether they were already played, with a brief on-screen note when duplicates are skipped.

item.title: Version 3.26.3
item.description: • Revert “Mark as Played / Not Played” no longer leaves a played track stranded below a queued one. Fixes mark as played selection not working on single tracks.

item.title: Version 3.26.2
item.description:
• Fixed (Built-in Player): after pausing a track and dragging another queued track above it, pressing play now starts the new top track instead of resuming the paused one.
  • Fixed (Setlist): “Mark as Played / Not Played” no longer leaves a played track stranded below a queued one — the played block stays a contiguous group at the top.

item.title: Version 3.26.1
item.description: • Fixed (Custom Text Lines): deleting a custom line — especially immediately after adding it — could crash the app. The visibility and editor lists now use stable id-keyed bindings instead of array-index bindings, so deletes are safe regardless of timing.

item.title: Version 3.26.0
item.description: • New (Custom Text Lines): add unlimited free-text lines to the display for dance tracks and the cortina "coming up" preview. Each line supports metadata placeholders ({Artist} {Title} {Genre} {Year} {Singer} {AlbumArtist} {Comment} {Grouping}, case-insensitive), its own font, size, bold/italic and colour, independent Dance / Next Up visibility, and can be reordered among the built-in fields. Managed in Appearance › Visibility › Custom Lines.

item.title: Version 3.25.5
item.description:
• Fixed (Setlist paste): pasting tracks copied from foobar2000 now works — foobar2000 writes file paths as bare POSIX strings rather than file:// URLs, which the previous clipboard reader missed.
  • Fixed (build): resolved a Swift type-checker timeout that broke the build on older Intel Macs.

item.title: Version 3.25.4
item.description: • Fixed (Setlist + JRiver): when dragging a mixed batch of tracks with Duplicate Protection enabled and "Add" chosen for all duplicates, duplicate tracks could appear before fresh tracks at the drop position — now all tracks insert in original drag order at the correct position.

item.title: Version 3.25.3
item.description: • Fixed: drag insert position now always respected when Duplicate Track Protection is enabled — previously, accepted duplicate tracks were appended to the end of the setlist instead of the drop position.

item.title: Version 3.25.2
item.description:
• DJ Name: show your name on the dancer display — configurable corner or centred position, with a "Show when" control (any track playing / idle & paused / always).
  • Fixed: when dragging a mixed batch with Duplicate Protection on, duplicates could be inserted at the drop position instead of the end of the setlist.

item.title: Version 3.25.1
item.description:
• Waveform window reliability: fixed intermittent "No track playing" flashes during track-to-track transitions and when pausing an early-marked track; the waveform now stays connected throughout.
  • Waveform toolbar button: the button is now enabled whenever tracks are loaded in the setlist, not only when a track is actively playing.

item.title: Version 3.25.0
item.description:
• Performance Mode: mark any setlist track as a performance track (right-click › Mark as Performance). When it plays, the dancer display switches to a custom performance view with a dedicated background image and fully configurable text lines — font, size, colour, and {title} / {artist} / {genre} / {year} placeholders. A "Show during cortina" option pre-announces the performance on the cortina screen. Playback stops automatically after each performance track by default.
  • Waveform Window: a compact floating window showing the audio waveform of the current track with a live playhead, elapsed time, and total duration. Open it via the Waveform button in the Setlist toolbar.
  • Track Tagging: colour-code any setlist track for visual organisation. Right-click › Tag Colour to assign red, orange, yellow, green, blue, or purple. A coloured dot appears on the row and tags persist in the saved setlist.

item.title: Version 3.24.4
item.description:
• New Set Timings window: click the status bar timing info to open a floating dashboard showing total set time, remaining tracks, next cortina countdown, and estimated end time in large-format display
  • Fix: Dragging in tracks once all played and 'Hide Played' is ON, now performs correctly

item.title: Version 3.24.3
item.description: • Fixed crash when playing a mono audio file with an AU plugin active — mono audio is now automatically upmixed to stereo before reaching the plugin chain, so the plugin stays active and processes the track correctly. Previously the incompatible plugin was disabled as a workaround; it now works as expected.

item.title: Version 3.24.2
item.description:
• Plugin Configurations: save and recall named AU plugin chain settings; assign a configuration to individual setlist tracks; tracks with an assigned configuration display a badge in the setlist.
  • Fixed crash when playing a mono (or otherwise format-incompatible) audio file while a stereo-only AU plugin (e.g. FabFilter Transient Gizmo) is active; the incompatible plugin is now gracefully disabled instead.

item.title: Version 3.24.1
item.description:
• More third-party plugins now appear: the plugin browser also lists Music Effect Audio Units (kAudioUnitType_MusicEffect), not just plain effects — so plugins such as FabFilter Pro-Q 4 that register as music effects now show up and can be added to the chain.
  • Fixed a crash when opening some third-party plugin editors (e.g. FabFilter Pro-Q 4). Plugins now load out-of-process by default so a plugin's editor or processing crash is isolated from TangoDisplay. A small in-process allowlist (currently Klanghelm MJUC) keeps plugin-driven window auto-resize working where it's needed.

item.title: Version 3.24.0
item.description:
• Audio Unit Plugin Chain (new): the Setlist player can now host up to 4 Audio Units in series instead of a single Apple-bundled plugin. Configure the chain in Player Settings › Audio Unit Plugins: add plugins, reorder with the up/down arrows, replace or remove individual slots, open each plugin's editor window, and save/recall presets per slot. A toolbar popover in the Setlist view gives quick chain access for live use — bypass the whole chain, toggle individual slots on or off, and open editor windows.
  • Third-party plugins supported: the browser now lists every Audio Unit effect installed on the system (e.g. FabFilter Pro-Q4, Klanghelm MJUC), not just the curated Apple effects. AUv3 plugins load out-of-process via XPC so a plugin crash is isolated from TangoDisplay; AUv2 plugins load in-process. Third-party Audio Units run at your own risk — an unstable plugin may still interrupt playback.
  • The legacy single-plugin setting from previous versions is migrated automatically into slot 1 of the new chain on first launch.

item.title: Version 3.23.0
item.description:
• Setlist Remote (new): toggle on in Settings › Player › Setlist Remote to control volume, cortina volume, and replay gain from your phone over Wi-Fi. A built-in web page shows the URL and a QR code; a 4-digit PIN regenerates each time the app launches.
  • Genre Backgrounds (new): enable in Appearance › Artwork & Motion to assign a background image per genre (and one for cortinas), driven by your Cortina Rules entries. Priority: artist → genre → profile background → background colour.
  • Multi-line Advanced Transformations: use \n in a transformation's Replace with field to split the displayed value across lines (also \r, \t, and \\ for a literal backslash). The live preview renders the wrapped result.
  • Album Artwork Edge Fade (new): new slider in Appearance › Artwork & Motion › Album Artwork that softly fades the edges of album art into the background.

item.title: Version 3.22.1
item.description: • Fix: dragging a large multi-track selection from Music.app into the Setlist no longer truncates to a handful of tracks. The drop handler was reading the Music-specific promise pasteboard flavor (present on only a subset of items) instead of public.file-url (present on nearly every item), causing the rest of the selection to be silently dropped.

item.title: Version 3.22.0
item.description:
• Startup Mode (new): choose how TangoDisplay launches in Settings › Startup. Full Experience opens both the Live Display and Settings window with Settings brought forward. Player Focused starts the Live Display minimised to the Dock with Settings focused.
  • Hide Left Menu Bar on Startup (new): collapse the Settings sidebar at launch. Expand it again at any time.
  • Cortina volume: new slider in Settings › Player › Cortinas (-10 to 0 dB) that attenuates the playback level of tracks identified as cortinas on top of ReplayGain. Default 0 dB (off).

item.title: Version 3.21.10
item.description: • Fixed: with Hide Played on, returning to the Setlist tab after switching to another tab no longer briefly hides (or de-emphasises) the currently playing track when it is past its mark-as-played threshold.

item.title: Version 3.21.9
item.description: • Fixed: with Hide Played on, dragging in new tracks now lands in the correct slot. Reordering and deleting rows in the filtered list also now affect the row you actually clicked.

item.title: Version 3.21.8
item.description:
• Hide Played: new toolbar toggle (filter icon) that hides fully-played tracks so the current track stays at the top of the visible list. The active track is always shown even when early-marked as played. Preference is persisted across sessions.
  • Fixed: unplugging headphones (or any audio device change) on the System Default output no longer causes the current track to skip unexpectedly.
  • Fixed album artwork overflowing its panel — artwork is now constrained to the same size as the setlist logo placeholder.

item.title: Version 3.21.7
item.description:
• Decibel Meter: real-time room noise monitor in the Setlist toolbar. Enable in Settings > Player > Decibel Meter and set your acceptable noise range with the interactive colour-coded slider (blue = too quiet, green = acceptable, red = too loud)
  • Practical Use Case: As the noise level can often vary between the DJ booth and the floor, set the noise level with a professional noise meter at floor level. Measure at the desk and set the acceptable range in Setlist.
  • Built-in Player settings reorganised into logical groups (Playback, Cortinas, Safety, Appearance) for clarity
  • Updated app icon

item.title: Version 3.21.6
item.description:
• Track counter position is now configurable: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right, or centred inline with track text
  • When set to "Centred (in text order)", the counter appears as part of the text stack and can be reordered via Appearance > Visibility > Text Order for Dance Tracks
  • Position setting is in Display > Control Window, below the Show Track Counter toggle

item.title: Version 3.21.5
item.description:
• Setlist: status bar now shows total duration when two or more tracks are selected
  • JRiver Media Centre: fixed an issue where the next-track display could briefly show a stale cortina after a playback position update

item.title: Version 3.21.4
item.description:
• Fix: iTunes-purchased AAC tracks downloaded on macOS Sequoia can now be dragged from Music.app into the Setlist
  • On first launch macOS now prompts to allow access to your Apple Music library, which is required for these drags to be routed by the system

item.title: Version 3.21.3
item.description: • Fix: Music.app drag-and-drop now correctly highlights and accepts tracks that Music.app no longer provides as file URLs (post-~July 2022 purchases)

item.title: Version 3.21.2
item.description: • Fix: tracks dragged from Music.app (post-~July 2022 purchases) now land in the Setlist correctly

item.title: Version 3.21.1
item.description: • Fix: tracks purchased from Apple Music after July 2022 can now be dragged directly from the Music library into the Setlist on macOS Sequoia

item.title: Version 3.21.0
item.description:
• Audio Unit plugin presets: save named presets, apply factory presets, and auto-restore the last-used preset when the plugin loads
  • Preset bar added to the plugin floating window — "Preset:" picker and "Save as Preset…" button accessible without opening Settings
  • Preset label resets to None when you edit any parameter directly in the plugin window

item.title: Version 3.20.1
item.description: • Fix: Changing the audio output device while a setlist track was paused incorrectly triggered auto-advance to the next track and started playback. The player now stays paused when the output device is changed.

item.title: Version 3.20.0
item.description:
• New: Focus Mode — single-window split view combining live preview and setlist (⌘⇧F). Collapsible controls panel with Force Poll, Override, Pause Display, and Last Tanda.
  • New: Hog Mode playback-interrupted alert — if another app claims the audio device during active playback, an alert appears with Retry and OK buttons.

item.title: Version 3.19.1
item.description:
• Fix: Singer from Grouping field now correctly shown in the upcoming-track display during cortinas when using the Embrace player
  • Fix: Grouping tag now shown in Setlist for tracks added before the Grouping feature was introduced (one-time metadata refresh on first launch)

item.title: Version 3.19.0
item.description:
• New: Grouping metadata field — read from Music.app, Swinsian, Embrace, J River, and audio file tags; optionally shown in setlist rows and selectable as the singer source on the dancer display
  • New: Exclusive Mode (Hog Mode) for built-in player — claim exclusive access to the selected audio interface, with conflict detection and a Retry button
  • Fix: Duplicate cortinas in setlist now tracked correctly by UUID
  • Fix: Remaining set time and estimated end time account for auto-fade cortina effective play duration
  • Fix: "Stop After Playing" can now target the currently playing track

item.title: Version 3.18.4
item.description:
• macOS Tahoe (26.x) compatibility: menu bar icon migrated from deprecated NSStatusItem to MenuBarExtra
  • Sparkle updated to 2.9.2 for Tahoe update-alert compatibility

item.title: Version 3.18.3
item.description:
• Override Text (⌘⇧O) now has its own font and colour settings in Appearance
  • When paused, pressing play again bypasses auto-gap and plays immediately
  • Auto-gap calculation simplified: gap applied only when existing silence falls short
  • Artwork tab: new artist entry auto-focuses the name field; remove button uses trash icon
  • Setlist report: Played card shows played/total count; currently-playing track shown as played in setlist view

item.title: Version 3.18.2
item.description:
• Setlist player: unplayed tracks now appear in semibold with full-brightness text when genre colours are disabled, making them visually distinct from played tracks.
  • Setlist player: Cortina tracks always display bold/bright regardless of genre colour rules, so tanda breaks are easy to spot.

item.title: Version 3.18.1
item.description: • Fixed a crash when generating Setlist Reports on the installed app.

item.title: Version 3.18.0
item.description:
• MegaSeg integration (Beta) — TangoDisplay can now monitor MegaSeg Pro as a player source. Select MegaSeg in Settings › Player to enable. Genre is looked up from MegaSeg's own library database, with Music.app's iTunes Library as a fallback.
  • MegaSeg workflow notes: The display updates only when a track starts on MegaSeg's program (main) output. Pre-listening in the cue deck (headphones) never affects the display. Playlist look-ahead is only available when playing from a loaded MegaSeg queue. Tanda counting requires a loaded playlist. Requires MegaSeg v5.9.4 or later.
  • Please test and report results — this integration is marked Beta because real-world DJ workflows with MegaSeg vary widely. If you use MegaSeg, please try it and report any issues.

item.title: Version 3.17.0
item.description:
• Setlist Reports — Export any setlist as a self-contained HTML report with genre breakdown charts, top-track ranking, per-tanda summaries, and an interactive searchable track table. Save reports from the Share menu in the Setlist tab; open, combine, and export from the new Reports tab in the sidebar.
  • Genre fallback for Music.app library — Tracks whose genre is stored only in Music.app's iTunes Library.xml (not embedded in the audio file) are now correctly picked up by all genre-dependent features (cortina detection, genre colours, setlist stats).

item.title: Version 3.16.7
item.description:
• Built-in player renamed "Setlist (Built-In Player)" — appears first in the player list and is now the default for fresh installs, with a "Recommended" badge in Settings › Player
  • Cortina denylist editor redesigned as a cleaner three-column layout (Genre | Display label | Controls)
  • Setlist state (paused, queued, played) now persists to disk immediately
  • Context menu now shows only relevant options depending on track state
  • Removed unused "Last Tanda Label" colour setting from Appearance › Colours

item.title: Version 3.16.6
item.description: • ⌘V paste now works with Foobar2000 — copy tracks with ⌘C in Foobar2000 and paste them directly into the Setlist panel

item.title: Version 3.16.5
item.description:
• Add tracks by pressing ⌘V — copy audio files in Finder, Music.app, or Swinsian with ⌘C, then press ⌘V while the Setlist panel is focused to append them instantly
  • Genre colour now optionally extends to the song title — enable "Include song title" in Settings › Player › Genre Colours

item.title: Version 3.16.4
item.description: • Playback progress bar moves into the currently-playing track row — elapsed time, remaining time, mark-as-played threshold, and auto-fade marker now appear directly on the row

item.title: Version 3.16.3
item.description: • Add customisable genre tag colours to the Setlist player. Assign a colour to any genre keyword — keywords match case-insensitively and partially (e.g. "tango" matches "Argentine Tango"). Colours apply only to upcoming unplayed tracks; playing, paused, and already-played tracks keep their standard colours.

item.title: Version 3.16.2
item.description:
• Setlist status bar: added "Next cortina" countdown showing time until the next cortina
  • Setlist status bar: added remaining track count alongside total playlist duration
  • Setlist status bar: fixed "Ends at" time to correctly account for remaining time of the currently playing track

item.title: Version 3.16.1
item.description:
• Sparkle update dialog now shows a clean release notes summary instead of the full GitHub page
  • Update dialog now appears automatically on launch when a new version is available

item.title: Version 3.16.0
item.description:
• Audio Unit Plugin support (Beta) — load EQ, dynamics, and filter plugins into the audio chain
  • Plugin picker filtered to restoration-relevant AU plugins only
  • Quick-access plugin button in the Setlist toolbar
  • Fixed: switching plugins no longer shows the previous plugin's editor window

item.title: Version 3.15.4
item.description: • Automatic update notifications via Sparkle — TangoDisplay now prompts you when a new version is available and can install it in one click

item.title: Version 3.15.3
item.description:
• Fix: Year tag now reads correctly from AIFF files tagged with ID3v2.2 (TYE frame)
  • Fix: Year tag now reads correctly from files using the ID3v2.4 TDRC frame
